name: monoforge
description: The struct-family factory: stamps a new fleet repo from proven template blocks, doctors it for truth, and locks it. Generated green is never shipped: the doctor refuses placeholder text and unverified gates.

scripts.test: node test/run.mjs && node test/version-truth.mjs && node test/distribution-run.mjs && node --test test/templates.test.cjs test/workers-compat.test.mjs test/harness.test.mjs test/packs.test.mjs test/ship-from-download.test.cjs test/release-verify.test.cjs test/docs-frontmatter.test.cjs test/web-imports.test.cjs test/status.test.mjs && node --test test/check-action-pins.test.cjs && node --test test/check-prestruct-pins.test.cjs
scripts.lint:docs: node scripts/check-docs-frontmatter.cjs && node scripts/check-docs-links.cjs && node scripts/check-docs-style.cjs && node scripts/check-fiction-signatures.cjs && node scripts/check-jekyll-filters.cjs
scripts.check: npm test && npm run lint:docs && npm run lint:pins && npm run lint:prestruct-pins && npm run lint:language && npm run lint:packs && npm run conform:packs && npm run packs
